snapshot.title: GCS-02 Network Isolation Status

fields.title: Critical Resource Status
fields.incidentName: Silent Lockdown — NAS Ransomware & Client Data Exposure

resources.name: GCS-02 (10.17.40.17)
resources.notes: Offline (Isolated) — Network isolation confirmed by HUOG-FW01 (10.17.41.1). No access to Flight Ops VLAN. Mount point corrupted. Treated as infected.

resources.name: HUOG-NAS01
resources.notes: Access restricted. Snapshot schedule disabled. Processing scripts failing. PL-02 and PL-06 data accessed during unauthorized window.

resources.name: HUOG-PROC01
resources.notes: Unauthorized script 'backup_fix_temp.py' detected in /tmp/scripts/. Quarantined by MSSP. No active processing.

resources.name: Flight Ops VLAN
resources.notes: Isolated at HUOG-FW01. All GCS devices blocked from accessing NAS and processing workstations.

resources.name: CP&L Campaign D-3 (raw data)
resources.notes: Data integrity compromised. Hash mismatch confirmed. Delivery deadline at risk. Client notification required within 4 hours.

resources.name: Offline Backup OB-1
resources.notes: Last good snapshot: 03/20/2026. Three weeks outdated. Not usable for recovery.

resources.name: Field LAN (192.168.88.0/24)
resources.notes: DAA-1 and FIELD-RTR-1 still operational. No evidence of compromise. Monitoring for lateral movement.

resources.name: Data VLAN (10.17.41.0/24)
resources.notes: Isolated from office network. All shares blocked. No access to NAS, PROC, or CAL01.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the network isolation of GCS-02 and escalates the status of critical systems. The IC must log the event in the hazard log per FOM 11.1 and reaffirm the fleet's avoidance of GCS-02.
